player.nativePlayerLauncher.getItOnThe.source: Get it on the App Store

player.nativePlayerLauncher.watchThisVid.source: Watch this video in the AOC app.

player.nativePlayerLauncher.yourInstitut.source: Your institute plays lesson videos in the AOC app on phones and tablets. Get the app, sign in, and open this lesson there.

player.nativePlayerLauncher.thisVideoCan.source: This video can only be watched on a Windows computer with the AOC Player.

player.error.unavailable.source: This video isn't available. It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it.

player.error.notEnrolled.source: Enroll in this course to watch its lessons.

player.error.paymentRequired.source: This lesson needs a payment before you can watch it.

player.error.paymentPending.source: Your payment for this lesson is awaiting confirmation. You can watch once it's confirmed.

player.error.notStarted.source: This lesson hasn't started yet. Its videos open when the lesson starts.

player.error.expired.source: This lesson has ended, so its videos can no longer be watched.

player.error.device.source: This course can only be watched on your registered devices, and this device isn't one of them.

player.error.loadFailed.source: Couldn't load this video. Please try again.

player.error.processing.source: This video is still processing. Try again in a few minutes.

player.error.youtubeDisabled.source: YouTube videos can't be played right now. Please try again later.

player.error.channelUnavailable.source: This video's channel isn't available right now.

player.error.aocUnavailable.source: The AOC Player isn't available right now. Please try again later.

player.error.watchLimit.source: You've used all the watch time allowed for this video. Ask your institute if you need more time.

player.error.signInAgain.source: Sign out and sign in again on this device, then open the video in the AOC Player.

player.error.notNow.source: This video isn't available right now.

player.secure.keyRefused.source: The video host refused to unlock this video for playback. Ask your institute to check the video host's security settings.

player.secure.embedOnly.source: This video plays in the AOC Player. Open the lesson there to watch it.

player.secure.limitReached.source: This viewing session has ended because a limit was reached.

player.secure.noSeeking.source: Seeking isn't allowed for this video.

player.secure.sessionInvalid.source: Your session is no longer valid. Reload to keep watching.

player.secure.unavailableDescription.source: It may have been removed, or you may not have access to it.

player.secure.seekDisabled.source: Seeking is disabled for this video.
